role: Preregistered contract for the v0.5 2D PDE term-discovery study. It asks which library terms are present, not only a scalar viscosity. It holds no v0.5 test number. It does not edit v0.4 or v0.4.1 artifacts.
question: With sparse noisy sensors of the existing 2D Burgers and vorticity-form Navier-Stokes generators, can weak-form sparse regression (WSINDy) recover the exact PDE support — the true terms and no extras — on raw probes and on fields denoised by a reused 2D FNO, against a frozen 80% seed-success bar at 1% noise?
not_claimed: a result on The Well shear_flow or Petrobras 3W
that the recovered coefficients are more accurate than a solver-in-the-loop viscosity fit
that the library is complete for other PDEs
that PySR was run; it is skipped for the reason stored under methods.pysr
a retuned pass bar after seeing test scores
an architecture, width, mode count, or STLSQ threshold that is optimal outside this frozen set
a change to any v0.4 or v0.4.1 number, protocol, or score file

aggregation.unit: one support set per seed per method per noise, from a single STLSQ fit that stacks every primary-family test instance
aggregation.seed_success: the recovered support equals the true support of that family
aggregation.exact_support_rate: fraction of the five seeds that succeed
aggregation.instance_exact_rate: mean over seeds of the fraction of test instances whose own STLSQ support is exact
aggregation.coeff_rel_error: mean over test instances and true terms of |c_hat - c_true| / max(|c_true|, 1e-12), after a least-squares refit of the recovered support on that instance

splits.assignment: by instance id before any windowing: train 0..n_train-1, validation n_train..n_train+n_val-1, test n_train+n_val..total-1
splits.note: The generator's n_val slot is the validation split used only to choose the STLSQ threshold.

ns2d.pde: ω_t + u · ∇ω = nu Δω + f,  u = ∇^⊥ ψ,  −Δψ = ω

sensors.name: sensors64_lattice_bursts
sensors.layout: 8 by 8 equispaced lattice, stride 8 on the 64 by 64 grid

noise.model: additive iid Gaussian on observed field values, scaled by the clean-field standard deviation of that instance
noise.per_seed: realization seed is noise_seed + 100 * seed so the five seeds are distinct at every positive noise fraction

library.role: Frozen candidate terms. Derivatives of linear terms can move onto the test function; mixed products use spectral derivatives of the field on the grid that method sees.

burgers2d.stacking: rows of the u-equation and the v-equation are stacked; q is that component

wsindy.estimator: numpy WSINDy: compact polynomial test functions, trapezoidal quadrature, sequential thresholded least squares

test_function.time: one bump on each sensor burst

stlsq.selection: on the validation split only: maximize the number of primary-family validation instances with exact support; ties take the largest threshold

wsindy_raw.role: WSINDy on the 8 by 8 sensor lattice. The field is not lifted and not denoised.

wsindy_fno.role: WSINDy on a 64 by 64 field produced by the denoising FNO from the sensor lift

pysr.reason: PySR 2.x requires a Julia runtime and a SymbolicRegression.jl compile. That is outside this CPU-only free budget, is not a package extra, and is not available in CI. The study does not install it and does not score it.

fno_denoiser.reuse: the v0.4/v0.4.1 FNO2d class, trained as a field denoiser rather than a viscosity-conditioned rollout
fno_denoiser.input: noisy trigonometric lift of every saved frame, channels = n_frames * n_components
fno_denoiser.output: clean full field of the same shape
fno_denoiser.checkpoint: lowest validation relative L2 on clean targets

pass_bars.statement: correct support in >= 80% of seeds at 1% noise for at least one method on each problem
pass_bars.overall: pass only if each problem has at least one method whose exact_support_rate at noise 0.01 is >= 0.8

compute.ci: tiny smoke only: N=8, three frames, one manufactured library, one STLSQ recovery. CI never trains the study.
